caption.en: The head of page 164 of Hampton Institute's 1909 songbook, this song's earliest known printing: its black-letter title over the refrain, headed "Chorus", in A-flat major and 2/4 time.

source: Religious Folk Songs of the Negro as Sung on the Plantations, new edition, arranged by the musical directors of the Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute (Hampton, Va.: The Institute Press, 1909), p. 164, "Ezekiel Saw de Wheel"; top of the page (the title, "Chorus" and the first treble staff only, cut above the words)

caption.en: Page 60 of R. Nathaniel Dett's Religious Folk-Songs of the Negro as Sung at Hampton Institute (1927), the page our arrangement is read from: the 1909 setting with a tempo, a quarter note at 90, and the refrain marked "Tutti", for everyone.
caption.es: La página 60 de Religious Folk-Songs of the Negro as Sung at Hampton Institute (1927), de R. Nathaniel Dett, la página de la que está tomado nuestro arreglo: la armonización de 1909 con un tempo, negra a 90, y el estribillo marcado "Tutti", para todos.
